A = data('envoy_cluster_upstream_cx_connect_ms_sum', rollup='delta').sum(by=['k8s.pod.name', 'service.name']).publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = (A).max().publish(label='B')
C = (A).percentile(pct=50).publish(label='C')
D = (A).percentile(pct=75).publish(label='D')
E = (A).percentile(pct=90).publish(label='E')
